svg.desc: A fixed robot body, evolving worlds, and a promotion gate on unseen homes. Promotion requires 80% success across 20 held-out apartments and zero falls. No policy has qualified yet. Built with MUJOCO, FALKORDB, PYTHON, BUILT IN 4.5 HOURS.
